name: renaiss-merchant
description: Renaiss Merchant Copilot monorepo root (client + server)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run prepare:hosting
scripts.build:path: npm run build:client:path && npm run prepare:hosting
scripts.deploy:merchant-site: npm run build:root && npx -y firebase-tools@13 deploy --only hosting:merchant --config firebase.merchant-site.json --project dokipoki-dev --non-interactive
scripts.test:ci: npm run check:server && npm run test:server && npm run test:client && npm run build
